text:
Ms. Jennifer Adams
Social Worker
Elizabeth Community Health Center

26/11/2017

Dear Ms. Jennifer Adams,

Re: Mr. Martin Wilson, a 62 year-old recently retired man

I am writing to refer Mr. Wilson, who was admitted to our hospital for an attempted suicide. He is now due to discharge and requires urgent attention for continuous support.

Mr. Wilson has been suffering from depression secondary to his gambling addiction, making him loose financial stability. He was hospitalized around ten days ago following a suicide attempt with an overdose of Mogodol. Since then, he has been placed on an anti-depressant, Lovan 200mg. However, only a little progress has been made as he stays depressed and underweight, with poor appetite. 

In terms of his social support, Mr. Wilson lives with his wife, Joan, and has three daughters and five grandchildren. None of them was aware of his addiction problem before the incidence. Therefore, this came as a shock to them, resulting in a mix of emotional issues between him and his family. However, he is motivated to overcome his addiction this time with remorse.

Could you please keep an eye on his physical and mental recovery? Please do not hesitate to contact me for any assistance you require regarding this patient.

Yours sincerely,
RN
